title: Coordinate process-job actor binding and recovery status seam

conditions.description: StartJobCommand and JobManager.startJobIn/startJobForTarget currently do not receive initiating actor; SignalR Client.fs lines 1220–1221 discard it, while process list/get/cancel are project-only. Pinned spec requires wrong-actor coverage and prohibits shared SignalR dispatch edits without coordination. Authorize exact StartJob dispatch actor propagation (or designate another owner to implement it) and Common.JobStatus explicit RecoveryUnknown case with required exhaustive consumer updates; Worker 14 will retain JobManager and dedicated tests ownership. No Program or scheduler edits.
